name: Nikya of the Old Ways
description: The Gruul leader of the Zhur-Taa clan, who listens to Ruzi and declares everyone loyal to the Rakdos demon guilty of a bloodcrime.

description_citations.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
description_citations.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi meets Nikya of the Zhur-Taa clan and tells her his sister and the infant were murdered by Rakdos.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Nikya, convinced by the bloodwriting her scouts saw, declares everyone loyal to the Rakdos demon guilty of a bloodcrime against the Gruul.
timeline.quote: They will be slaughtered in the streets where they live.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.
